messages:
sam: Hi finance team, I took a cab from the offsite last night and got hit with a peak surcharge. Paid on my personal card and uploaded to Ramp: https://ramp.app/receipts/xyz789. Filing as 'Taxi - personal'. receipt image attached.

lee: can you paste the image here? need to see pickup/dropoff and the time to apply policy.

sam: pasted — shows 2026-03-22 23:45, Downtown venue -> Manhattan apt. Fare $29.50, Peak surcharge $12.00, tip $5.00, total $46.50. i did add the $5 tip by cash.

pat: quick policy note: standard taxi reimbursement cap without manager approval is $40. over that requires manager justification for safety/last-train reasons. was transit available?

sam: trains were running but there was a crowding advisory and last inbound train was delayed per the MTA app. a few teammates took cabs. organizer @lee confirmed group left late.

lee: confirming — event ran late, shuttle options ended and MTA alert showed delays. i'm ok approving the excess for safety. please add my approval in the expense comments.

pat: tagging the expense audit bot — @expenses-bot confirm what docs we need for reimbursement?

expenses-bot: Please attach either a screenshot of the MTA delay alert or a short note from the event lead confirming late end time. Also include manager approval in the Ramp submission. Once attachments are present and manager approval recorded, reimbursement will be included in the next payroll run.

sam: added Lee's approval text and uploaded screenshot of the MTA delay. resubmitted in Ramp with comment: "Manager Lee approved extra $6.50 due to MTA delay 3/22."

pat: thanks — we'll process up to the full amount given manager approval. expect reimbursement in 3-6 business days after processing.

sam: amazing, thanks all :pray:
